values.note: All four sites reservable up to 5 days before arrival (the FS page says 4); unreserved sites then go walk-up and must be occupied the same night. Walk-ups are exempt from the weekend/holiday minimums, and recreation.gov marks the weekend minimum soft, so it may be relaxed for a same-day booking.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233722 (notice 'Reservations are available up to 5 days prior to arrival date. Sites not reserved 5 days before become walk-up'; rules minWeekendStay 2 soft, maxConsecutiveStay 14, reservationCutOff 5; rates Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-10-11) + FS page ('A minimum stay on Friday and Saturday night is required on weekends. A three-night minimum stay is required on holiday weekends. Walk-ups are exempt from the nightly minimum.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $24 a site, 2026-2028; a one-time $11 Eleven Mile Canyon entry fee per stay; no third vehicle (no overflow parking).

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233722/rates (STANDARD NONELECTRIC 24, 2026-2028) + notices ('a one-time fee of $11.00 to enter Eleven Mile Canyon Recreation Area'; 'This campground has no overflow parking available for a third vehicle') + FS page ('$24 fee per site'), read 2026-10-28

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/cove-campground ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites.'), read 2026-10-28

note: South Park RD (Pike-San Isabel NF), concessionaire-run: a tiny primitive campground on the South Platte River in Eleven Mile Canyon at ~9,900 ft, ~5 miles up gravel CR 96 from Lake George and just below Eleven Mile Reservoir; anglers and climbers. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov: 4 sites (1 tent-only), vault toilet, hand-pump water, no hookups, $24 (2026-28) plus a one-time $11 canyon fee. Max length 34 (note-derived) replaced by the FS page's 16 ft - a CRITERIA problem (see flags). Added season, booking (rec.gov to 5 days out then walk-up, 2/3-night weekend/holiday minimum, 14 nights, reservation season May 15 - Oct 11), senior/access discount. Pin 67 m from the site centroid; OK. Riverfront plausible (sites 1-2 ~25 m from the river across open ground). Note corrected (wrong district) and trimmed.
flags: CRITERIA (drop candidate): FS page 'Parking for two vehicles or one RV are allowed at each site. Max RV length is 16 feet.' recreation.gov agrees the sites are small: site 1 tent-only, sites 2-4 back-in with max vehicle 20/25/25 ft and permitted equipment Tent / Trailer / Pop up only (no RV type, so EKKO can't book it as a motorhome). The FS page's own description ('parking spurs 25-34 feet') conflicts with its 16-ft RV limit; the stored 34 came from that line. No review from the last 3 years with a reviewer's own 23 ft+ rig was found in this pass.
Missing phone: South Park Ranger District, 719-836-2031 (FS page). recreation.gov lists the concessionaire (goexplorus.com) at (661) 702-1420.
Wrong district in the old note: the FS page puts Cove in the South Park Ranger District, not 'South Park/Tarryall (South Platte RD)'.
Website: stored link is the recreation.gov booking page only; the FS page is https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/cove-campground.

Riverfront not re-audited in depth: sites 1-2 are ~25 m and sites 3-4 ~50 m from the South Platte across open grass and brush (imagery); stored 'riverfront' looks consistent but site 1 is the tent-only one.
